# PickWorth

> PickWorth is an independent review site that hands-on tests AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek, Grok, Perplexity and more).
> Honest, price-verified verdicts, head-to-head comparisons, and best-of lists, written by a single editorial team.
> No ads in reviews, no paid placement. Method: https://pickworth.top/blog/how-we-test-ai-tools/

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://pickworth.top/): Know which AI tools are actually worth paying for.
- [Tool Reviews](https://pickworth.top/tools/): Reviews of ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek, Grok, and Perplexity with verified prices and our 0-5 score.
- [Comparisons](https://pickworth.top/comparisons/): Head-to-head matchups scored per dimension, with the cost question answered.
- [Best-Of Lists](https://pickworth.top/lists/): Buyer's guides that pick the right tool by your actual job, not the loudest marketing.
- [Journal](https://pickworth.top/blog/): Essays on how we test, why prices move, and when open source matters.
- [About](https://pickworth.top/about/): Editorial standards, who funds the site, and why funding never touches the verdicts.
- [Contact](https://pickworth.top/contact/): Report an error or request a comparison.

Where the front-end and image work leads, where reasoning slips, and why the benchmarks are self-reported.
- [ChatGPT Review: What It Is Good At and Where It Slips (2026)]: https://pickworth.top/tools/chatgpt/ - ChatGPT review where it leads on everyday tasks and multimodal input, where it trips on long documents, and which plan is actually worth paying for.
- [Claude Review: Where It Pulls Ahead and Where It Doesn't (2026)]: https://pickworth.top/tools/claude/ - Claude review where it beats other assistants on long documents and instruction-following, where the ecosystem gap is real, and what the tiers cost.
- [DeepSeek Review: The Open-Weight Model That Keeps the Price Floor Low (2026)]: https://pickworth.top/tools/deepseek/ - DeepSeek review where the open-weights model earns its cost, where the free chat tier actually runs out, and what the API pricing means for production.
- [ElevenLabs Review 2026: Where It Leads on Voice, and What the Free Plan Actually Gives]: https://pickworth.top/tools/elevenlabs/ - ElevenLabs review, the most realistic text-to-speech and voice cloning in the category, the per-character credit system, and what the free plan truly unlocks before you pay.
- [Google Gemini Review 2026: What It Is Good At, Where It Slips, and the Plans]: https://pickworth.top/tools/gemini/ - Google Gemini review, where it leads on research, long documents and the Google ecosystem, where the free tier caps you, and which of the four plans is actually worth paying for.
- [GitHub Copilot Review 2026: What It Is Good At, Where It Slips, and the Plans]: https://pickworth.top/tools/github-copilot/ - GitHub Copilot review where it leads on inline completion and in-editor help, where the free tier caps out, and which plan is actually worth paying for, including the student and open-source routes.
- [Grok Review: xAI's Assistant for the Whole X Firehose (2026)]: https://pickworth.top/tools/grok/ - Grok review what the live-X knowledge actually buys, where the open-weights and coding tools are going, and the trust questions a buyer should ask.
- [Perplexity Review: The AI Search Engine That Cites Its Sources (2026)]: https://pickworth.top/tools/perplexity/ - Perplexity review where the AI search engine beats a normal search box, where its free tier actually runs out, and what the Pro tier is worth.

## Journal & Analysis
- [Context Windows, Explained Without the Headline Numbers]: https://pickworth.top/blog/context-windows-explained/ - What a context window actually does, why a bigger one is not automatically better, and the two questions that decide whether it matters for your work.
- [Getting GitHub Copilot Pro for Free: The Student, Teacher, and Open-Source Route]: https://pickworth.top/blog/get-github-copilot-pro-free/ - The free tier is not the only free option: verified students, teachers, and maintainers of popular open-source projects get the full Pro plan at $0. How to check eligibility and claim it, and what the free grant actually covers.
- [How We Test AI Tools (and Why the Answer Keeps Changing)]: https://pickworth.top/blog/how-we-test-ai-tools/ - Our testing method, written out in full: the fixed prompt set, the repetition problem, the limits we measure and the claims we refuse to repeat.
- [The $20 Rule: How Much to Spend on AI Tools]: https://pickworth.top/blog/the-20-dollar-rule/ - One $20 subscription covers most people's AI needs; a second earns its place only for a specific job. The rule we use to decide when to add a tool.
- [When Open Source Actually Matters (and When It Is Just a Label)]: https://pickworth.top/blog/when-open-source-matters/ - Open weights are not automatically better. The four conditions under which open source genuinely changes the decision and when it is just preference.
- [Why AI Tool Prices Move (and the Pattern Behind Every Change)]: https://pickworth.top/blog/why-prices-move/ - The repricing pattern in AI tools: a generous launch, a quiet tightening, then a restructured tier. How to buy without getting caught.
